versions.changelog: v2.0: 完整架构 - 三层存储 + 自动蒸馏 + 重要性权重

Initial release of memory-vector-bge skill.

- Provides automated memory distillation from daily logs, storing key information as vectors.
- Enables semantic search using the BGE-M3 vector model for efficient memory retrieval.
- Automatically updates a core set of memories in MEMORY.md to control token usage.
- Includes scripts for both manual and automated processing (distillation and search).
- Sensitive information is automatically filtered from stored vectors.
- Requires Ollama running locally with the BGE-M3 model installed.
